mapper.select: SELECT 1 AS locked FROM ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(#{userId})) ) lock_call
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile ( user_id, display_name, birthday, pronouns, timezone, locale, preferences ) VALUES ( CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{displayName}, #{birthday}, #{pronouns}, #{timezone}, #{locale}, COALESCE(CAST(#{preferences,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, birthday = EXCLUDED.birthday, pronouns = EXCLUDED.pronouns, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, locale = EXCLUDED.locale, preferences = EXCLUDED.preferences, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT user_id::varchar AS user_id, display_name, birthday, pronouns, timezone, locale, preferences, created_at, updated_at FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aura_profile ( id, user_id, nickname, persona_summary, voice_style, appearance, boundaries ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{userId} AS uuid), #{nickname}, #{personaSummary}, #{voiceStyle}, #{appearance}, #{boundaries} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname, persona_summary = EXCLUDED.persona_summary, voice_style = EXCLUDED.voice_style, appearance = EXCLUDED.appearance, boundaries = EXCLUDED.boundaries, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id::varchar AS id, user_id::varchar AS user_id, nickname, persona_summary, voice_style, appearance, boundaries, created_at, updated_at FROM aura_profile WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
